sources: Mind's Eye Theatre: Laws of the East (WW05016), "The Bonds of Immortality: Kuei-jin & Guanxi", p.123, read directly: a wu-mate's own named bond rating, formula 5 + (wu-mate's Charisma-related Social Traits) - (your own P'o or Yin, whichever is higher). Named per wu-mate the same way Vampire's own Bonds block names a bond per Kindred - no fixed catalog of names, a rating against each one a chronicle's own play creates.
